hint.text: Commas are used to separate extra information from the rest of the sentence. There should be a comma before and after the added information.

instruction.text: Select the sentence that correctly uses punctuation for the extra information.

b: ++Rachel, who teaches at the school, is Isabelle’s parent.
Rachel who teaches, at the school, is Isabelle’s parent.
I am going, to visit, my grandad who is my dad’s father, on Thursday.
++I am going to visit my grandad, who is my dad’s father, on Thursday.
++The college, which I would like to attend next year, offers a wide range of courses.
The college which I would like to attend next year, offers, a wide range of courses.
The, flowers which I planted in the garden last spring, have grown beautifully.
++The flowers, which I planted in the garden last spring, have grown beautifully.

instruction.text: Are the commas in the following sentence in the right place?

atoms.a: Sasha, who I went to school with, is coming to dinner this week.
The cross-country race, which I ran last week, was very difficult.
The, sandwich which I bought for, lunch is very tasty.

atoms.b: The sandwich((,)) which I bought for lunch((,)) is very tasty.

instruction.text: Are the commas in the following sentence in the right place?

atoms.a: The guitar which, I bought last week is, broken.

atoms.b: The guitar((,)) which I bought last week((,))is broken.

instruction.text: Are the commas in the following sentence in the right place?

atoms.a: Helen’s interview, which she had prepared for, went well.
My cat who is, three years old has, been missing for two days.

atoms.b: My cat((,)) who is three years old((,)) has been missing for two days.
